market_outlook.short_term: Cautious and volatile. US equities likely to consolidate after 3-day selloff as oil and bond yields stabilize intraday. BOJ decision and Iran conflict are dominant swing factors. Expect 5-8% VIX elevation. Bond yields may pause near decade highs but remain elevated. Yen volatility to persist. Tech names (Dell, Nvidia) provide selective pockets of strength.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive for AI infrastructure and energy transition despite near-term noise. $31.6T data center capex cycle supports multi-year upside for hardware and power names. Bond yields at decade highs create attractive entry points for patient capital. Geopolitical risks (Iran) are episodic but inflation pass-through could delay global easing cycle by 1-2 quarters. Apple transition and Meta AI search pivot are structural catalysts.
